manifest.name: nvfp4-gptq-mlp-gdn-fp8-all-attn-q4k-lmhead-q4k
manifest.description: #102 (RP-KL 0.0688, decode 88.7) already runs the recurrent qkv of layers 1-63 in FP8. This keeps the rest of #102 as it is (nvfp4_gptq on every MLP, attention on runtime Q4_K, nvfp4_blockfit on layer 0, lm_head fitted once) and moves the recurrent z and out projections of layers 1-63 to FP8 too, so the whole recurrent path after layer 0 runs FP8. FP8 on the recurrent path has been the largest single drop in drift on this track; V3 shows the cost of all of it (about 83 tok/s decode, about 1 GiB more peak memory). Layer 0 stays NVFP4 so the first-layer prefill path is untouched. Expect lower RP-KL than #102 at lower decode.
